recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core follow-up is needed for FHIR-16043 unless the work group wants a new, separate editorial decision to prefer the HIE Whitepaper over the current IHE Technical Framework Volume 3 mapping target.
issue_request: FHIR-16043 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 correction asking that the XDS mapping title/link stop pointing at the incorrect IHE XDS URL and instead use the high-level IHE Document Sharing page.
initial_application: The issue was applied in SVN revision 14435, represented in git by abeeef31ad618c79908690c096f45280c52a09c6, which added the DocShare wiki link to source/mappingSpaces.xml while leaving the XDS mapping identity in place.
additional_context: The current build-source mapping space is source/mappingSpaces.xml and the active DocumentReference/List StructureDefinition sources carry the xds mapping. Later IHE cleanup commits moved away from the obsolete IHE wiki and old http://ihe.net/xds URL: fc1c850e10045b56e0318c993b61a26f5c8ab04b changed the mapping URI toward profiles.ihe.net, and bc76b5717ebb4df34226f826f1a17e48093cfdd9 updated the mapping space plus DocumentReference/List mapping URIs and names to the current IHE Technical Framework Volume 3 location and "IHE Document Sharing (e.g. XDS) metadata Mapping" wording.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current source no longer contains the stale mapping URL or DocShare wiki mapping link that FHIR-16043 targeted, and the remaining XDS mapping definitions consistently point to current IHE profiles content.
